text: The accepted provider-button stylesheet centers the label part, constrains the icon to 16 CSS pixels and uses margin-inline-end. In this button family, recommend logical end spacing so the icon/text gap follows writing direction. This is a scoped CSS pattern; the exact icon size is local to this chooser and is not a rule for all Thunderbird icons. No right-to-left, zoom, icon rendering or button layout check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source adoption does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Filelink provider icons use logical spacing in the local button layout
